purpose: Train and independently assess descriptive dialogue semantics without teaching policy permission or copying expected bank outcomes.
unit: One actually delivered customer turn plus the legitimately available pre-turn context; spans use original-text Unicode code-point half-open offsets.

source_policy.trace_extraction: Store exact observed utterance and source offsets; clipped or contradictory actor speech is labelled as delivered with ambiguity when appropriate. Never silently repair it to the intended script. Preserve separate intended-script divergence metadata.
source_policy.public_corpora: Banking77 labels can support their original intent categories or reviewed linguistic inspiration, not collections-policy/consent/completion truth. Taskmaster-3 gives conversational examples, not this bank's tool permissions. Inherited inspiration must retain pinned source locator/hash/license and all derivative lineage. Dataset splits retain their original names in provenance even when used for another local task; never claim an official dataset test score after training on its test text.
source_policy.teacher: Teacher/generated labels are weak proposals. Record exact model/prompt/source and adjudicate separately. Never call an LLM evaluator independent merely because it is another invocation of the same authoring process.
source_policy.gold: Gold means independently reviewed semantic evidence, not automatic correctness. At least two blind annotations and adjudication for safety-critical target, correction, polarity and affirmation cases; unresolved disagreement remains unknown/masked.
source_policy.weight_limit: Weights are declared heuristics for training only, not calibrated label reliability. Calibration and qualification require adjudicated labels; if unavailable mark those stages unqualified.

label_heads.primary_intent: Intent enum in semantic_proposal.v1; descriptive main act, using current question role. Record ambiguity set when two acts are inseparable. Do not copy policy precedence into language truth.
label_heads.secondary_intents: Multi-label set; every annotated act carries evidence. Empty set means reviewed absence; null means unannotated and must be masked. Administrative questions are not discarded.
label_heads.clause_segmentation: Contiguous or explicitly linked spans; retain heterogeneous targets and clauses, including shared collective group.
label_heads.target_scope: single | explicit_set | all_returned | current_question | unresolved; candidate refs point into legitimate input targets. Annotate collective reference, deictic reference and ambiguity.
label_heads.amount_scope: per_target | each | aggregate_total | absent | unresolved; a total is not each amount.
label_heads.components: For each target-scoped amount/date/time/security_answer/recipient/allocation: complete | unfinished | absent | ambiguous. Completeness means linguistic completeness, not policy validity. Independently record actual value span, reference and polarity.
label_heads.polarity: asserted | negated | conditional | questioned | quoted | unknown at component/clause scope. Lexical no/not is evidence to interpret, not an automatic uncertain label.
label_heads.correction: none | replacement | retraction | refinement | unresolved; annotate target/component scope and superseded reference when context establishes it. Complete corrections remain complete.
label_heads.offer_reference: Which actually spoken active offer the acceptance refers to, or unresolved; context specifies exact offer ID and revisions. This is distinct from newly stated values.
label_heads.consent_signal: none | affirmative | negative | qualified | ambiguous with evidence and candidate readback reference. This describes language only; permission is never a train label.
label_heads.administrative_question: ai | purpose | legitimacy | discount | other as multi-label spans; separate from request for human or support acceptance.
label_heads.abstention_annotation: Record ambiguity cause and scope, not one blanket must_abstain derived from the presence of a negation/correction. Partial facts may be known while the joint frame is unresolved.
label_heads.mask: Explicit Boolean observed/annotated mask per head/component; missing is not negative. Illegal combinations are adjudication errors, not silently repaired labels.

grouping_algorithm.step_1: Build a graph of record lineage before fitting. Connect all turns and repetitions of one scenario/bank fixture, the same source conversation/document, the same actor script/template, corrections/paraphrases/translations/number substitutions, teacher examples derived from the same seed, and augmentation descendants.
grouping_algorithm.step_2: Detect exact normalized duplicates and near-duplicate text or known template skeletons. Manually review candidate clusters; changing product name, number or topic noun does not create an independent template. Generic shared language alone is not sufficient to merge unrelated records.
grouping_algorithm.step_3: Assign whole connected components to splits using deterministic seeded group allocation, balancing only training/development labels. Freeze IDs/hash/seed and overlap checks before fitting or threshold selection.
grouping_algorithm.step_4: Reserve OOD axes deliberately: unseen conversation/actor-author source, lexical/paraphrase family, clause composition, target interleaving, correction order, ambiguity/negation scope, language/noise, and unseen policy/API schema supplied as input. Do not count a random split as OOD.
grouping_algorithm.step_5: Publish group count and authors/generators per split. If lineage joins everything, collect new independently authored groups rather than weaken grouping or rename sources by split.
grouping_algorithm.fractions: Illustrative allocation only when enough independent groups: train 50%, development 10%, calibration_fit 10%, calibration_risk 10%, confirmation 10%, OOD qualification 10%. Statistical qualification depends on absolute effective group counts; tiny data cannot satisfy these roles by slicing a few examples.
grouping_algorithm.current_v1: 52 train, 22 calibration, 22 holdout authored examples. Declared family counts 20/11/11, source counts 2/1/1; same author and shared carriers. Existing integrity checks are useful but do not establish independent semantic templates or OOD. Holdout has now been reviewed adaptively and becomes diagnostic_only for future versions; retain its original frozen results.
grouping_algorithm.new_v2: Create a new versioned pack and split manifest. Do not edit/relabel/reshuffle v1 to improve scores. Independent reviewer/author supplies new confirmation and OOD groups without exposing their text/labels to the model-development worker until weights, features, thresholds and guards are frozen.

review_workflow: Annotator A sees delivered turn and legitimate prior context, not model prediction, expected ledger, case pass or actor future script.
Annotator B independently sees the same permitted input; compare span, scope and per-head agreement.
Adjudicator resolves against the delivered evidence, recording both original labels and rationale. Unresolvable context remains unknown; do not force one label.
Keep actor_adherence, judge_disagreement, source_policy_ambiguity and infrastructure_incomplete separate; none automatically changes semantic truth.
Use masked labels for partial annotation. Qualify gold head counts, not just total row count.
Freeze record and label hashes before evaluation. After any adaptive inspection retire that qualification set to diagnostic status for subsequent versions.
trace_specific_handling: A4/B9/A5 passed cases may contain semantic mistakes masked by later recovery; annotate turns, not case verdict.
A4 PUB10 failed judge allegations do not label the mandatory opening as a premature promise acknowledgement; preserve original verdict in separate evaluation metadata.
A5 recovered PUB02 inconclusive judge remains combined-fail/unqualified even if callback ledger is correct.
B9 authored actor ending after a readback supplies no affirmative consent. Do not manufacture a yes from the intended script.
Opus source-only proposed attacks are authored hypotheses; only a pinned observed producer/consumer witness upgrades execution evidence.
No bank policy floor/date/outcome/queue is learned from public fixture constants. Such terms are source-derived at builder/runtime and evaluated separately.

minimum_next_deliverable.priority_1: Paired identical utterances under different recipient/security/offer/readback/support contexts, including yes/no/date/digits.
minimum_next_deliverable.priority_2: Target-scoped amount/date completion in both orders with interleaved products; partial correction preserves complete sibling.
minimum_next_deliverable.priority_3: Negation and qualification scope, complete stop/refusal, security+purpose, third-party+callback, hardship+voluntary proposal and restructuring+admin question.
minimum_next_deliverable.priority_4: Offer acceptance after calendar adjustment and after administrative detour; exact offer identity and subsequent readback reference.
minimum_next_deliverable.count: Aim first for annotation coverage of every contract head and critical interaction, not an arbitrary row total. Publish actual independent group counts and missing labels; no fabricated qualification.

checkpoints.scope: Additive design clarification; no v1 data/model/metrics edits or new experiment claims.

axes.semantic_truth: What the delivered turn means in legitimate prior context, per head/component with spans and ambiguity.
axes.model_capability: What the current trained/exported model can support; stored in capability manifest, never used to change semantic gold.
axes.consumer_decision: Which supported dependencies permit a proposal to enter a specific deterministic consumer; not a train label for bank permission.

mask_rules: An unfinished date can coexist with a known payment intent, complete amount and resolved target. Label each independently.
A complete negative imperative can be stop_request. Negation is scoped to contact, not a reason to label primary unknown or completion unfinished.
A complete correction is completion=complete plus correction=replacement/retraction/refinement; correction and negation are not completion classes.
No secondary acts means reviewed empty set. Missing annotation is null/unannotated with loss maskfalse. Candidate detector no-match and not_implemented are not annotated_absent.
For partial multi-label annotation, use per-label observed masks. Do not treat every unmentioned intent as negative unless the entire intent inventory was reviewed.

Preserve alternative interpretations and disputed spans; do not invent a single label merely to fit a softmax. Mask ambiguous scalar training loss or use a declared set-valued objective; evaluate ambiguity handling separately.
Known stop plus unrelated unfinished admin tail retains stop semantics. Unknown relation/retraction scope may block a dependent decision; do not universally erase known heads.

Train no must_abstain label mechanically from completion. Derive scoped semantic ambiguity flags from annotation; runtime abstention also depends on source trust, capability, OOD, calibration and consumer dependencies.
orthogonal_supervision_contract.loss_interface: Each labelled item carries head_id, scope_id, value_or_alternatives, evidence_spans, observed_mask, annotator_ids, review_status and training_weight. Targets/component refs point to legitimate input identities, not fixture names used as learned class IDs.
orthogonal_supervision_contract.wire_compatibility: This is annotation metadata, not a silent change to semantic_proposal.v1. Follow current output schema and explicit versioning.

rules: Freeze detector version before candidate-head table. Generate actual candidates for every TRAIN row, including reviewed absent-amount/date rows. Align one-to-one by kind and exact original Unicode spans to reviewed gold; no nearest-span relabeling.

Unmatched candidates become validity/noncomponent negatives only when reviewed whole-turn annotations establish falsity. Mask unreviewed regions. Card suffix/clock/date digits are potential non-amount candidates; do not treat them as unfinished money or train a completion head to infer presence.

Train completion/polarity only on exact matched candidates under per-axis masks. Missed gold spans count as detector false negatives, not excluded pipeline successes. Oracle-span analysis and actual-detector evaluation stay separate.

Security question must not switch detector to whole-turn capture. Use field-aligned spans only with trusted security-field descriptor; otherwise unsupported_context. Keep unrelated admin intent separate. Security values, including spelled numbers, cannot enter lexical/suffix feature vocabulary.
If security isolation unavailable, mask all turn surface features for security-role pilot and report lost admin capability; digit substitution alone is not privacy protection.

pilot.positive: Linguistically complete date expression, even if vague, invalid, conditional, quoted or unresolved anaphor. Those other axes remain separate.
pilot.negative: Genuinely unfinished date expression judged from delivered current source plus admissible prior context; not punctuation alone or the authors intended future script.
pilot.masked: Linguistic finishedness disputed/ambiguous, unknown source framing, unreviewed span, unisolated secret, unsupported detector role, or normalization-only dispute mistakenly offered as negative.
pilot.absent: Reviewed absence used in detector regression denominators, not forced complete/unfinished target.
pilot.continuation: A fragment completing prior text requires an exact prior unresolved source-event link and component token. Without it, mark unsupported_context; no synthetic concatenation from future turns.

collection.target: 24 genuinely new conservatively grouped TRAIN roots, each aiming2-4 reviewed members;8 separately conceived dev roots;8 no-date/competing-kind detector-regression roots. Targets only, never claim achieved counts.
collection.floor: At least20 fully independently reviewed/adjudicated canonical TRAIN groups with complete examples AND20 with unfinished examples. SAME paired roots may contribute to both class-support counts; total independent denominator counts each once. This differs from primary20 additional-negative-root gate. No IID claim follows.
collection.lineage: Complete/unfinished/context/punctuation variants share root. Union reused carriers, source episodes and descendants across old/new packs before split. Never turn24 recipe variations from one carrier into24 groups. If unions leave fewer than20, gather new roots or keep readiness closed.
collection.authoring: New origins and constructions must be independently conceived before seeing candidate predictions. Store author/model/prompt/source hashes and actual delivered turns; source-author independence is not proven by a reviewer.
collection.independent_annotation: Two non-author reviewers annotate full source clause/date spans and completion before model/detector output exposure; preserve uncertainties and adjudication. Existing exposed reviews inform guidelines, not counterfeit fresh blind annotations.
collection.actual_detector_annotation: After source annotations frozen, attach frozen detector outputs and exact-span alignments. Review unmatched candidates and absent regions as a separate task; preserve original meanings. No detector-conditioned relabeling of missed gold to make predictions correct.
collection.dev: Separate reviewed dev roots with same axes and actual detector outputs. Used only for model diagnosis/selection; no calibration/risk/qualification claims. Freeze future qualification only after selected pipeline; never backfill it from these reviews.

constructions: Open date complement versus a completed complement, without forcing same punctuation pattern across classes.
Complete vague period/reference versus true unfinished comparator; next week/another date/that date stay complete.
Date complete plus unfinished TIME or administrative question; date class must remain complete.
Negated/quoted/conditional complete date; polarity must not be mistaken for completion.
Nonterminal hesitation followed by complete same/sibling date; ordered correction tracked independently.
One target unfinished while another has complete date; annotate both and preserve target uncertainty.
Complete impossible or weekday-conflicting calendar expression; normalization failure separate.
Actual linked turn continuation versus unanchored fragment; same utterance in different preceding contexts shares root.
Date-like security answer, clock digits, card/account suffix, puzzle numbers: reviewed detector negatives/unsupported contexts, not date unfinished labels.
checkpoint_06_date_annotation_protocol.candidate_span_policy: Review whole delivered clause first. Complete date span includes all value words/modifiers needed for its meaning; unfinished open date complement includes available words such as the third of... without inventing missing suffix. Identify prefix/context separately. Proposer must offer both complete and open-complement candidates; source question may support a date role, not force completion label. Exact match uses frozen span convention; alternative/discontinuous spans explicitly masked until supported.
checkpoint_06_date_annotation_protocol.source_review_before_detector: Annotators freeze source meaning/spans without seeing predictions. Only then review actual detector misses/false candidates; cannot backfill gold to detector output.

exact_source_paths.use: Exact current delivered user text and offsets, after explicit exclusion/redaction policy. No extractor rewrite promoted to trusted raw source.
Role and actual last spoken question text; IDs bind provenance only. Question text must also pass secret-value exclusion; no future assistant text.
Frozen enum; unknown/out-of-scope explicit abstention. Phase-only comparator required.
Validate unique actual indices and membership. Map symbolic relationships without exposing bank IDs/names/suffixes. Never assume targets[].target_index exists.
Read actual nested shape; typed status and component names may be features. Opaque revision tokens go to deterministic freshness decoder, never lexical model features.

Only independently checked presence, kind, completed speech, current-versus-superseded relation and question-linked scope are categorical features. Exact IDs, amounts/dates and registry revisions are decoder/provenance data, not labels.
Date experiment markers from frozen proposer, never manually supplied gold spans in deployment. Exact source-map alignment; clipping/overflow explicit.

shared_features.privacy: For this minimal experiment include only source-proven fictional NON-security rows containing no DOB/answer content, even in mixed payment/admin turns. Metadata source eligibility is a dataset admission filter, not a learned feature. No raw security training/cache/logging or teacher calls. Question.role!=security alone is insufficient. If value-free projection cannot be established, exclude/mask the row and report lost coverage; do not claim a deployed perfect redactor. General raw-voice privacy/ingress remain unqualified.
shared_features.delexicalization: Apply lexical value abstraction before typed context serialization. Never regex-replace numbers across serialized target maps. Use relative relations current_question_target/sibling/unresolved and typed component statuses; if local aliases needed use consistent opaque aliases with target-permutation controls. Exact money/calendar values remain deterministic normalization input, not a hidden training label.
shared_features.source_map: Each lexical segment maps to original turn or actual spoken-question event and offsets. Synthetic role/candidate markers identified as markers with no source span. IDs/digests in manifest only, not model text. No raw-text hashes of short security values. Model/data artifact SHA256 remains valid provenance.
parity_controls: Actual frozen input with targets[].index and nested pending components must serialize successfully without flattening statuses.
Renaming source IDs and permuting target enumeration with relationships preserved must preserve semantic model input/prediction up to alias canonicalization.
Same turn different valid question role should differ only in admissible role/question features; same phase with changed reference validity tests phase confounding.
No forbidden secret-word/number token in admitted input, feature vocabulary or embedding cache; unknown secret isolation excludes row.
Teacher input/CPU features derive from identical source view; teacher must not receive hidden canonical terms, full future context or gold spans.

latest_primary_review.exposure: Reviewer reused from prior40-row audit, explicitly not newly blind. One real annotation/member; no second annotation or adjudication fabricated.
latest_primary_review.readiness: NO-GO; these latest observed counts supersede weak author support as evidence of what reviewer actually labelled. They are not admitted training labels.

checkpoint_06_atomic_component_truth.input: Immutable evidence rows with actual source spans, known target, per-component linguistic status/value candidate, explicit unresolved components and correction edges. Whole-row c alone never establishes component truth or permission.
algorithm: Parse every row to immutable evidence; never mutate pending state or shared needs while iterating serialized rows.
For row r, U_r is ONLY explicit unfinished components from a supported partial/c0 observation. A complete/c1 row contributes U_r=empty; absent amount/date keys in a complete row do not create needs.

A partial row may contain a separately complete amount while its date is unfinished. Preserve that amount evidence when its own scoped span is complete, not listed unfinished, and deterministic parse succeeds.
Union explicit U_r per target; independently collect complete values/references per component. Resolve explicit supersession/conflicts from speech spans and correction edges, never list order.

For each target/component with one consistent independently complete resolved survivor, retain its value and remove that component from the combined unresolved set. Do not cancel genuinely later retraction/unfinished replacement, conflicting values or unknown correction scope.
After all rows, produce one candidate target patch/diagnostic. Kernel remains sole state owner and independently validates policy; current learned shadow emits no patch or bank action.
checkpoint_06_atomic_component_truth.equations: E_tc=union_r scoped_evidence(r,t,c); U_t=union_r explicit_c0_u(r,t). Resolve(E_tc,source_order,explicit_correction_edges) determines complete_current(t,c). U_final[t]=(U_old[t] union U_t union invalidations[t]) minus {c:complete_current(t,c) and dependencies_valid(t,c)}. Complete(c1) rows add no U. If resolve is conflict/unknown, keep unresolved; qualified=false keeps all learned claims abstaining.
tests: Same speech: partial row has complete amount and unfinished date; sibling row supplies complete date. Both serialization orders retain amount/date and empty date need when explicit completion link is consistent.
Same speech: complete date plus partial amount row retains date while amount remains unresolved. Missing field in complete date row does not erase a known amount.
Two all-complete nonconflicting rows in both orders match existing passing control; separate-turn completion retains earlier sibling.
Explicit later speech correction/retraction overrides earlier evidence only through scoped relation. Changing speech correction order is NOT an invariance requirement.
Complete primary with unrelated conditional clause is retained; condition on primary itself remains conditional/blocked. c1 alone never authorizes deceased/stop/transfer.
Complete date in a conditional/quoted sentence is still linguistically complete; decoder separately blocks commitment when unsupported. No global if/no/not veto.

Benign negative idiom attached to mind/problem does not mechanically negate confirmation; withdrawal or new terms still block exact-readback consent. Keep semantic uncertainty abstaining, not a canned acceptance allowlist.

Actual transport receipt must bind original dispatched operation ID if adapter supports it. Ambient current request ID cannot authenticate old receipt. This is deterministic transport work; no model learns HTTP retry policy.
checkpoint_06_atomic_component_truth.date_training_effect: Add complete-date versus truly unfinished-date pairs under independent if/admin clauses. Do not label conditional complete dates unfinished. Partial-amount/date-complete pairs are complete-date positives. Detector alignment must preserve independent clause boundaries and old/new correction spans.

review_protocol: Freeze exact full packet, all source inputs, semantic guidelines, lineage union/closure manifest and hashes before reviewer dispatch. Preserve source-only input fields; keep weak labels, prior reviews, predictions and sampling strata inaccessible.

Two fresh non-author reviewers each annotate every member of the SAME versioned packet independently. Neither sees the other answers before their annotations freeze. Store actual identity, exposure and completed-member evidence; no fabricated blind registry.

Guidelines may define axes using separate illustrative examples, but must exclude prior row-specific adjudications/answers for this packet. Source-specific decisions in designer documents are adjudicator material, not fresh-blind reviewer input.

Parent adjudicates disagreements after both reviews freeze; ambiguous primary labels remain masked rather than forced to reach a quota. Canonical unions and full closure apply before final support counts.

Any supplemental member or lineage union discovered later requires packet revision and review coverage for affected full groups; keep previous annotation snapshots. All annotation work remains TRAIN development, not calibration or qualification.

mask_contract.review_flow: Let the two fresh TRAIN source-only reviews finish without feeding them these predictions. Parent checks packet hashes, complete membership, independently annotates/adjudicates disagreements. Freeze overlay and canonical unions. Then separate absent-region/unmatched-candidate audit; no pretend blind registry after exposure.
mask_contract.exact_positive: Review says valid date expression at exact span, present mask true; linguistic complete/unfinished agreed; source/private isolation and feature window eligible => completion mask true. Includes complete vague, negated, quoted, conditional, invalid calendar and unresolved anaphor when linguistic finishedness is independently clear.
mask_contract.detector_miss: Count as pipeline false negative against reviewed true span. No example for conditional head loss, no fabricated candidate from label spans at runtime, no false label absent.
mask_contract.unmatched: Mask validity/completion/polarity until separate review. Three oldDEV overlaps are boundary mismatches, not automatic negative validity. No positive label from nearest overlap; no negative from missing gold alone.
mask_contract.reviewed_negative: Only independently reviewed no-date/competing-kind region supports validity negative; source annotation must cover candidate region and kind. Such negatives test proposer/abstention and are not unfinished DATE training labels.
mask_contract.capability: not_implemented, no_candidate, boundary_ambiguous, reference_unresolved, untrained_head, source_unqualified and normalization_invalid are distinct diagnostic reasons. Existing wire placeholders do not mean semantic ambiguous ground truth.
mask_contract.old_DEV_overlay: Potential complete-expression/reference distinctions for0156/0160/0161/0162/0167/0168/0175 require separate review. Do not recode their old ambiguous labels or claim improvement without new adjudication; quoted0158 and quoted recipient0159 show scope failures independent of finishedness.
mask_contract.qualification: OldDEV and theseTRAIN diagnostics exposed. Freeze detector/features/head/decoder/schema before fresh calibration-fit then independent risk/qualification groups. No newDEV labels read here; once used for development it is not qualification.

span_contract.unit: Maximal contiguous local temporal expression with determiners/internal complements, optional year and open operators; keep terminal truncation punctuation only when it belongs to that expression. Exclude unrelated final sentence punctuation, introducing payment verb and unrelated following clause. Leading on is outside a full expression but retained as the sole evidence of an open date complement when no content follows. This convention is a proposed annotation contract, not a retroactive redefinition of old scores.
span_contract.coordination: A range/alternative remains one candidate when syntactically linked (from A to B / either A or B). Separate same/sibling-target clauses remain separate; source correction edges retain direction. Ambiguous ownership produces boundary/scope mask, not whole-turn union.
span_contract.cross_clause: Do not broaden over hard semicolon/new sentence/sibling clause. If relation genuinely spans clauses, keep atom spans plus unsupported composite relation sidecar and mask the narrow binary classifier; old0161 cannot be recovered by swallowing its whole turn merely to match authored span.
span_contract.ambiguity: No currency/date canonical value inferred by this proposer. Date-like word May in a modal clause, standalone number, surname or identifier stays unsupported/competing unless local syntax supports a date. Question role is support, never permission to label every answer a date.
span_contract.limits: Input<=4096codepoints, <=16candidates and<=12localclauses; candidate<=512codepoints. Overflow abstains without truncating candidate list. Keep local clause IDs independent of128character source turnID.
span_contract.security: Preserve R3 security-field isolation and whole-turn lexical masking when trustworthy field separation unavailable. No source secret, DOB/token or sibling secret text in DATE features, including question text. Never treat security_date as payment_date.

checkpoint_08_candidate_review_masks.readiness: CurrentR3 candidates cover<=7canonicalDATEgroups total. Actual20/20aligned reviewed class floor closed even before review. No original label changes or invented independent gold.
